review: "Had a delightful breakfast at Sangeetha, Adyar. The flavors were authentic, the food was fresh and delicious — a perfect start to the day - highly recommended for anyone who loves a good South Indian breakfast..
Delicious cuisine and the finest hotel in Chennai. Excellent service is offered at the hotel. Everyone should visit Sangeetha Hotel for a meal.
Vegetarian chain known for quick service. Food is dependable and the price reasonable. Can get really crowded during peak times.
We had to take a quick bite and so stopped at this restaurant. Food is of good quality with authentic taste. Service is quick. Restaurant is overpriced though, even though it is outside the airport.
In south and you dont tey this place will be an incomplete visit.The items are served heated to the core and really awsome and worth and remembered every moment

Sangeetha Dosai and Kara chuttney is becoming a brand for themselves, its time they  brand these offerings...  Would love to listen to some good classical music along at the restaurant... Apt message at the entrance on how one should behave in public... great going Sangeetha...!!! Can look at offering car service for better social distancing and hygiene though... Look forward to the same kick started...!!!

After day long shopping our family went to the restaurant around 8.00 pm last Saturday. The restaurant was over crowded and we had to wait for about 20 minutes to get our seats. While we were waiting outside , we heard some good cine songs. We thought  it was being played on a music system. Imagine our surprise , when we found two singers ( one male and one  female) crooning those melodies. It is quite uncommon to have live music in mid range restaurants in Chennai. The singers , particularly the male, were good singers. The food too was top class. We had a truly enjoyable experience. I learnt that live music is arranged on Thursday and Saturday nights only at the A/C dining hall. If you have not been there, I suggest you try it .You will not be disappointed.
Great food and excellent service by staff. Really friendly staff and quick service. Best veg food and hygienic too.
Sangeetha is a famous chain restaurant in Chennai. I had vegetarian thali here which was served with many South Indian dishes. Nice taste.

This review is  about the branch of Sangeetha restaurant located at the domestic departure terminal of Chennai Airport... OK that we do get good hot vegetarian Food from this restaurant..But cost of food is very much on the higher side. Since this is located outside the Airport we thought that  cost of dishes may not be that much high when compared to the Food available inside the Airport... However our presumption went wrong.. Prices are very much on the higher side. For eg: One  Dosa cost Rs. 161.90 one Ghee Idly Sambar costs Rs.190.48 The price mentioned above excludes GST. Hope the Hotel Management will look into this and reduce their cost price.
Had breakfast here on a whim as we were staying close by. Everything we ordered was fresh and delicious. All served quick and at remarkable prices. One just can't go wrong here!

Myself and my colleague had gone there to have meals on the way to IIT. We selected  this one over others, as it observed to be too crowded. We had a mini lunch there (costing Rs 130). It is with one chappathi and three variety rice. but quantity also seem to be just below to fill the appettite. Being new to the place, we dont know how much will be there in each order. The normal thali was 220. The service is fast and courteous, For ambience you can give 70% of 100.

This is a go to restaurant in Chennai, it is a landmark food destination in itself, offers a variety of Non A/c and A/c sitting. The staff is very cordial and service is very prompt. The south Indian snacks are freshly prepared and are absolutely yummy to say the least. Don't forget to order the cup of filter coffee. Was an absolute pleasure to dine here.
At  Sangeetha,you  can expect a  good service and  best  food taste. The pleasant  atmosphere  also  make the food even more taste

We reached here around 1130hrs - which is close to their "Lunch Service".  Most of the Day's Special Items were exhausted and we missed the Jack Fruit Halwa. Had to go in for Sarkarai Pongal followed by a Dosa, Mini Idlis in Sambhar, Thayir Vadai and Coffee.
Very popular place to eat and the vibe is good. I liked their rice dishes. The meals are so good to share.

we wanted to stay away from cooking on sunday so we decided to have lunch at Sangeetha Restaurant Gandhi nagar which is now renovated and expanded we opted for tamilnadu meals and we didnt regret the decision it was wholesome ,tasty , delicious and stomach filling ( if you are a voracious eater) reasonably priced it includes soup , sweet or icecream other than the usual curries , sambar , rasam etc. the highlight is the beeda which gives final touches to the lunch all veggies do visit sangeetha on any afternoon for Tamilnadu meals !!

I went there for breakfast and was pleasantly surprised by the place. It has a atmosphere of bygone restaurants in Chennai. It has a reputation for good South Indian breakfast items and it didnt disappoint. I had a rava dosa and it rocked and so did the filter coffee. A tip is to visit the place on Saturday morning because it turns out all the good special stuff is served then

This is one of my favorite restaurant in Chennai. Food is tasty and much variety. Don't miss to try out Beda (Sweet pan) which they have in the billing counter. It is very cheap and best. It is a MUST TRY.

The décor is different from other Sangeetha restaurants visited in Chennai. The available short eats, snacks are different from other places. You are requested to try the Ada (A rice preparation steamed in banana leaf) which is very delicious.  Please remember to look for the days when these special items are available. Also there is a restaurant in first floor where you can have regular lunch and dinner (I am yet to try this facility) It is a pleasure to write here that Sangeetha is very good for people who wants to have or love to have South Indian Vegetarian food and snacks.

During our stay at chennai our Aunty who lives at chennai took us to this non veg restaurant to had our lunch. Well it is a must try restaurant in chennai-- . We had butter masala dosa which is one of the best . And their must try is Faluda --- not miss it . oh I still can't forgot it -Must try
Central location, tasty food, variety of options, courteous and prompt services, economical too, a bit noisy, not very attractive ambience. Overall very satisfactory experience
Good place to eat with family in the Mount Road, Chennai. Parking facility helps to have a relaxed eat out. Lot of varieties and they are really Value for money. Big money with little harm to wallet.

I recently visited the Sangeetha Restaurant at Vandalur. The service was not timely due to the rush and paucity of space. The Airconditioned wing is cramped and free movement is difficult. However, the wait for the order was worth, as the food was good, specially the Masala dosais and Hot Bondas. It's mini meals is also good and also poori & potato. Fruit juices are also served. The tables are not cleaned immediately after the customer finishes his menu. As it is on the Highway I.e. On GST Road and opposite to Vandalur Zoo & Crescent Engineering College, it is always busy. Further, there is no other good veg restaurant nearby. There is also takeaway facility, but you have to wait more. There is ample parking facility. You can visit this Restaurant once in a while with your family & friends, whenever you pass through the GST Road or visit the famous and only zoo in Chennai. There is room for more improvement in service.

Sangeetha is a decent hotel at chennai and have many branches at various location. the food and tiffins are tasty and good. chettinad dishes and paper masala are very tasty. the hotel is neat and spacious. all most all kinds of dishes are served. one of the decent hotel. the food does not upset the stomach. the prices are reasonable.

The Sangeetha chain incorporates some of the best mid level restaurants for vegetarian food in Chennai. In fact their South Indian veg  fare is better than most five star restaurants and the prices are far more reasonable. The restaurant in Gandhi Nagar, Adyar is one of our favorites. The crowds, which so often cause you to wait to be seated, are the best testimony to the quality of the food. The rava dosai, masala dosi, puri and vadai are all excellent and I have rarely been able to go beyond them on multiple visits. The North Indian and "Chinese " menu are also very good as are the thalis. The menu features a good range of snacks as well. The filter coffee is suoerb. The service is polite and quick and they are able to tackle the crowd of diners quite efficiently. Excellent value for money.

I went to sangeetha in ecr chennai ...The service and the food was worst ...on top of it they were not able to manage the crowd also there ...sambar has so much water in it and I had a doubt whether it's rasam. ..lols ...but guys this place I will not visit again and not recommended ... Note..This review pertains only to east coast road branch ..

Long ago, on special occasions, me and my friends used to visit this restaurant. The food is really delicious. The ambience is good too. We used to go and wait from 7:30pm onwards to get a table. It is very crowded but worth it. Everything we order used to taste good. I hope they are still maintaining it the same way.

I've been there quite a few times usually for breakfast. Their dosai, idli and vadai all meet the high standards that Chennai sets for these items. The sambhar is tasty and you usually get 3 chutneys (onion, coriander and of course coconut). The pongal and pineapple kesari are also good but not the dishes to go for in case you do want to eat at least moderately healthy. On my many visits, I've had only one complaint where I felt the chutney was on the edge and the staff immediately replaced it with a different batch even though they felt it was ok. So they do take you seriously. The food is served super quick downstairs (the non-AC) section so it's not exactly a place where you can sit down and chat. Head upstairs to one of the AC halls in case you want to eat at a more leisurely place. The place can get busy especially at peak meal times, even the AC section might be busy at peak hours for anything more than eating (as in no time to sit down and chat). Staff never asks you to leave or anything like that but you do feel bad for the crowd standing and waiting with hungry eyes for a meal. The staff is happy to accommodate requests like less oil/no-oil on the dosai and the kitchen pulls it off without losing much on the taste. There's a wide selection including North Indian dishes for dinner but I've only had the South Indian dishes that they are more well known for. Staff are always courteous and prompt. A safe bet if you are in that part of Chennai - especially recommended for breakfast.

we were on the way from our Andaman trip to our place, planed lunch n Chennai.  we were 6, not interested to go any hotel. so we ordered lunch in sangeetha. Tamil Nadu lunch ..for 187 rs, we ordered 3 , but 2 might be enough for 6 of us. lots and lots of items, 2 sweets, fruit salad, veg, chappathi etc.... the quantity is much and taste good. dont miss that heavenly lunch. typical Tamil meals. you can order by phone befr you go, to avoid over crowd.
Visited this restaurant at the Chennai airport. Masala dosa is served hot along with a red chutney which is very tasty. Best option on Chennai airport.
One of the best appam with coconut milk , dosa and butter naan with planner batter masala . Had a Verily delicious, tasty and quality dinner with friends !! Must visit again !!
Loved the food - I had an onion rava masala dosa. Nothing to complain about there, but the waiter looked like he had no interest in waiting for us.

The South Indian thali meals here are excellent, having a good selection of traditional Tamil food. I'd recommend the South Indian thali over the North Indian one. The waiter we had seemed quite uninterested in taking our order and it brought down the experience. Overall, an excellent eatery, and worth the money.

Once during my visit to IIT Chennai, just happened to visit Sangeetha, Adyar luckily and it just wowed me with their wonderful Thali & Dosas. If you love South India dont miss this, else visit them to fall in love with South India Cuisine!!

Our cab driver suggested we try this place on our way back from T Nagar.We were a motley bunch of six with varying tastes and needs.We ordered one meal for the senior member while others had rawa dosa,chapati,masala dosa and dahi vada.All items were well prepared and I repeated my dahi vada.We tried some of the juices on offer which inflated our bill which was otherwise very reasonable.

we went to this sangeetha restaurant in thuraippakkam on the 25th july 2014 during snack time and ordered a curd vadai. when my friend opened the vada there was a small insect alive. we did not have the rest of the food there and paid the bill and moved on. this restaurant in the prime location is a boon to the i.t. corridor. but when you order food i suggest avoid the curd vada  in this restaurant. you might definitely find some insects  :-)
Really i felt very tasty to eat all kootu, poriyal with appalam. Even curd is good. Very tasty like home preparation. I miss the lunch..

I have visited Sangeetha (Adyar) hotel for lunch on a saturday, it was over crowded. They asked to wait for a while, then got a table inside A/C, order for full meals and it was really delicious. Ambiance was not that great, but many people opt in for the taste.
Good for a Quick Byte .... Liked Filter Cofee and Onion Rava Dosa which are my favourite ..

Sangeetha is one of the good vegetarian joints in Adyar having both A/C and non A/c options. both the places offer a wide variety of Veg food both south and north indian. all their food are made of olive oil which they claim is good for health. The food taste is definitely good making it a place to visit for veg food. they offer wide variety of dosas along with a good variety of chat items during the evenings. their south indian food fare much better than their north indian varieties. the challenge with the restaurant is Car parking. their limited car parking lots sometime make it a nightmare during peak hours. however they are now offering valet parking to mitigate this issue. Isspite of this it is must place for some good veg food in adyar.
This hotel is one of the best hotel in the chennai city providing good quality vegetarian food and also north in dishes.
The place has ample seating in multiple floors. The menu has several varieties to suit customers. The service is prompt and the food is very tasty and fresh. Parking is however a bit tough.

one of the best places to dine in chennai for veg food & especially veg south Indian cusines. The Hot Idli, onion utthapam and various kind of dosa served out here are really mouth watering & yummy to eat & not to forget the meals that are being served during lunch time. Must try one time if you are really hungry & have a heavy appetite.
Dont try the North Indian thali-your wallet and tummy both feel light and your heart feels the blues

This busy restaurant serves both South and North Indian dishes and also the "Indo-Chinese" style dishes. We ordered a selection of all three styles and were pleasantly surprised. They were well presented and tasty. The service is fast and smooth. Ice cream desserts are something that did not strike our fancy but the gulab jamuns were really good.

This is a famous south indian food chain restaurant. We went there for lunch. The south indian preparations are good . But everything here is tooo spicy.....not good for our health. I know south indian food is spicy but not that much. Saravanna Bhavan is better option.

The good parts about Sangeetha, Adyar: The food is still very good, though a tad down from what it used to be a few years ago. There is a large variety of South Indian, North Indian, Chinese, Continental and dessert fare on the menu. I have rarely seen the staff declare an item not available. And the food is served EXTREMELY fast. The bad: The tables are uncomfortably close to each other. Your neighbour will be able to hear every word that you speak. There is hardly any parking space, but the valets will do the job for you. Remember to get there early. Reach at 7 pm for dinner. If you arrive past 7.45, especially weekends, you will face a long wait.
We used to go to this restaurant regularly, most of the times to Guindy and Butt road outlets and we enjoy the food here. It is very hygienic and service also good.
Enjoyed my North Indian Thali in South India.... Masala Milk Too Good. South Indian Food also Too Good.

I tried dinner at Sangeetha Nungambakkam outlet in chennai and the food was tastey and worth of charges. The location is prime and service is prompt. They specialise in south Indian and have other options too. I tried chapathi korma, Mini meal with coffee and specially the masala milk was very good. A nice place for authentic pure vegetarian south indian delicacies

A place to have a quick breakfast south Indian style. Located centrally on the main road of Adyar. Many choices available. Always busy and crowded. Hot south Indian breakfast dishes available for a reasonable price. Reasonably clean. food is tasty with variety of side dishes

I have been to this place quite a number of times and love their food. Taste is great. You get both North Indian and South Indian dishes. Only drawback with this place is you have to wait for a long time to be seated. Its too crowded. If you don't have any plans after dining here, you are safe.

10th October, went for coffee in Chennai international airport. The quality of sambar vadai was very bad and not even worth for money. the service team didnot even requested for replacement. Very bad taste. Coffee was good.
meals are open from 10 : 45 am, cost is Rs 75 per person. Restaurant open from 7 am till 10: 30 at night.

++Great thali with very tasty food; will give Saravana Bhavan a run for its money any time ++Great service; wife and I had thali and veg manchurian came along with it; now, we were going to meet our son 20 minutes later and he loves manchurian; the waiter without a murmur agreed to pack the two veg manchurians into one bowl for our son(and this was a unlimited meal). My wife and I were zapped...Now beat that service, Saravana Bhavan ++Great price esp for an office lunch --Crowd and waiting(obviously will be) --Not enough of them my part of town(South West Chennai)

This have say rant is by far one of the best vegetarian restaurants in and  around chennai. They serve authentic south indian as well as north indian food with very friendly service. This place has got three floors of seating space which is totally full on weekends so you can imagine the quality of food n service they provide. Avoid going on weekends if you do not prefer waiting. The best part of the restaurant is the quality of food and ingredients they use to prepare is of the highest standards.  I am a daily customer to the place and sometimes I even go 2-3 times a day. N I must say am not the only one who does that.  I see a lot of people who come there daily with their families to have food.  They strictly use OLIVE Oil and double refined groundnut oil for cooking which makes u feel carerfree from having fried items. Must have - every item In southindan is a must try for a foodie esp in the mornings .  Other than that paav bhaji, dragon roll, and tikkas are outstanding .

Its a decent south Indian restaurant around Adya Decent place, good food but over priced. Service is not very  attentive.  Holidays the place gets very crowded and traffic on the road  makes it difficult to approach . No importance is given to maintenance  and staff can be better trained.  Breakfast items are very good.

Its situated in one of the happening areas of Chennai. Only serves good south Indian dishes. No good options for north Indian items. The so called North Indian thali does not have good quality items.Tried their 'Special Tea' and 'Special Coffee' and found nothing special about it at all. Most of the time the waiters are in a hurry to take your orders and make you eat your dishes super fast and make space for waiting guests as soon as possible !!

We had been to this restaurant on last Saturday.getting a table for six immediately made the ambience so cool.we ordered sambar vada as starter which was so good with small coconut  crunchy pieces in the vada.sambar was too good&authentic. Tomato soup also good in its taste with slight aroma of cinnamon . Butter nan was perfect with its supplements.kadai paneer was good with huge pieces of paneer&crunchy capsicum. Paneer tikka masala&alu gobi masala was fresh&tastefullydone. Cold coffee was too good to chill out.one sad thing was we were not given the basket of vadams before we place the order which was seen on other tables.keep going sangeetha!!!

This is the most popular veg eatery in our area, hence very crowded. The grouse is on not that, but the quality they have let the food down over time. All their dishes are progressively getting chilli hot, people with gentle lips and stomach stay away else you will be ER next day. Soup onwards you find this assault on your taste bud, where we felt even the well intentioned measure from the chef is getting defeated, they say they use pure ghee and olive oil for food preparation, pray some one tells them to use lesser chilli and gun powder in all the preparation and spare the guests

This place represents the current culinary picture of the South India. South India is known for its amazing cuisine but lately people are trying out North Indian (or Thandoori as they say it!) cuisine. Sangeetha is trying to do a lot of things at the same time , they serve good old local food as well as Chineese and North Indian (mainly Punjabi) cuisine as well and everything here is just average. The ambience is a little better than a typical tiffin place but the food is a let down...everything is just average, I bet you can get better dosas in any part of world...almost 80% of menu is other cuisines and not South Indian so its a bit of a irony! Overall you can avoid this place, it doesnt have a "positioning" that will appeal to anyone (whereas they are trying to appeal to everyone)
I have visited this restaurant several times and the food is awesome. The ambiance is average since the space is small and the crowd too heavy. overall it is a good place to visit
I have been there a couple of times and I have been satisfied with all my needs everytime.

We went to breakfast. The place was busy but they had only 1 person to take order and 1 person to serve. So it was a painful process to get their attention. If there was additional order, I had to walk up to the person to give the order as he would not come near our tables. The food was as usual, but some items took more than 20 mins. What bothered me most was that the cockroaches on tables, in AC. what am I paying for? Tried to talk to the staff but hey did not bother as they had people waiting.
South India filter Coffee is the best in Chennai . Great idly & sambar . good south indian meals . The service standards is also good .
Tasty South Indian food , Parking and crowd is an issue. Awesome quality.tomato soup is yummy. Service depends on crowd

This place is crowed  for most time ! Have been there more than 5 times ! Latest on Feb ! Few a times I have ordered Chinese and was really disappointed ! But the fact is they serve very good south Indian food. Their Platters are also good. Overall Good place for south Indian food.

Six of our family members visited the restaurant of the well-known chain of veg restaurants in Chennai for lunch to celiebrate the 70th birtday of our sister. We had ordered a mix of south-Indian, Chinese & north-Indian food, from ala carte menu. To our dismay, we found the food not upto the mark except for the south-Indian items and the chinese fried rice. Sangeetha is good only for South-Indian meals and tiffin like iddlies, dosas, etc (Most restaurants who claim multi-cuisine are not good in all cuisines except very few like Copper Chimney, Hot Chips, etc.)
Very good south Indian and a few north Indian dishes... A nice place to sit and watch the city traffic pass by...
The taste at Sangeetha was disappointing, considering the hype and the price. May be its because of the Olive oil being used for cooking.
They have a very wide variety and is good for South Indian cuisine, esp for bachelors who frequently need to eat out.
This is the place, a real good competition to the Saravanas, for that ubiquitous yet simple n delicious south Indian food.

Sangeetha Desi Veg is the place we go to the days we don't  feel like cooking but don't want to "eat out" either. Its not a fine dining place but its amazing food, its clean, the staff is professional yet polite and it's true blue fast food south indian style (altho the menu is quite extensive including north indian, chinese, continental and a big juice, mocktail and ice cream sundae section). And it's so economical, sometimes it's cheaper to eat there than at home. One of my favorites is to have the breakfast mini tiffin early morning after a walk on the beach. This place is by some means, an extension of eating at home. Never felt like sayin no 2 this place.

i have been to this restaurant alteast 100 times but can say that the quality and taste never gets compromised. The service, cleanliness and obviously the good taste is something you can look upto when you go there... i would suggest to try the ghee idlis (mini idlis), these are something you would love.... a must go restaurant if you are in chennai...

Safe, inexpensive good quality southie food. There are two options - you can take a meal coupon (Rs. 65) and sit in the non-AC area, get served at super speed, finish your meal and get going. Or you can go to the AC hall upstairs and have a more expensive meal with sweets etc at a relaxed pace.  I have tried both and liked both. Choose based on the time you have, the company you have and how hot a day it is :-)
simple vegeterian, south indian dishes are great. Rest you are taking a chance!

Its a good Veg Hotel in Chennai and i often used to Visit it. But recently i stopped visiting this hotel because of heavy crowds there.  I would have visited this hotel for almost more than 15-20 times. The Hotel has 4 floors Restaurant - Ground, First, Second and Terrace Restaurant.. And i visited first three..  Ground floor is non A/C, First floor is A/C Scenic, 2nd Floor is also for Visitor and exclusively for Party (A/C) and forth floor is only for buffet partying (Not sure if now exists).. Was a good hotel years ago but now because of crowd and hotel has become Dirty and noisy.. Pros - 1) Good Food for reasonable rate 2) A/C 3) Parking Available 4) Scenic road view at first floor. Cons - 1) Lifts wont work most of time making u walk up thru stairs, a problem for aged. 2) The hotel always has heavy crowds and most of time u have to wait in Queue to get a table. 3) Service has become little slow. (Varies). 4) Parking is there, but only Valet Parking. This means u have leave keys to the Valet guys, which is a problem if ur car is expensive or u have expensive item inside car. (Well not a big issue, its almost safe). 5) thou the hotel is the 1st main Road, the hotel is in the service land. So that u reach hotel u have go around long to get into service lane and reach hotel.. So Overall, thou there a some hindrances and u can tolerate them, and U r looking out for good food, this is the place.

One of the well know eateries / restaurant in chennai. Good quality food at decent prices. However the service is not as expected. The staff is unfriendly & dont really bother about the patrons. If service is important than look else where. You can visit Eden for that matter

Though I am a hardcore non-vegetarian, this is one place that has captured my sense of taste and tempts me to go again and again.. their chilli paneer, mushroom soup and kaju masala is just out of the worls.. i go to the branch on OMR and Velachery mostly...

This is a place we visit when there's no food at home, we are in our most casual clothes, there's no time to make reservations, no mood to try out a new fine dining or casual restaurant and we are HUNGRY! Time and again!! It could be at 7 in the morning or 11.30 in the night. That should, in short, sum up what Sangeetha, Gandhi Nagar, Adyar, is; mind you, this applies only to Sangeetha, Adyar and not any other Sangeetha in town (there are many - R A puram, Nungambakkam...) Their South Indian cuisine is a given in terms of quality (even if some dishes are slightly oily, they do not upset your stomach). But over the years, I have actually liked their version of noodles, pizza and icecream sundaes in their menu, though I have not tried these often. Of course, do not expect the authentic noodles, pizza and sundaes, but South Indian versions of these... now, to know what this is, visit the place and try it! Their pav bhaji is also surprisingly tasty, in fact, better than any other that I have tried in Chennai. I could say, close to the authentic and healthy too, oh yes, I do know what I'm talking about, having tasted pav bhaji in the four corners of India. I thought I should mention more about Sangeetha than their Chennai food, which is definitely above average.

The vegetarian lovers can have a best dining at sangeetha The prices are nominal for meals...any extra sides are ordered then the price May shoot up depending upon the variety selected. The mushroom pepper fry is an excellent sidedish. It can had with breads....the regular course meals are fair priced and the taste is very good I frequently visit sangeetha hotel for lunch Enjoy a good tasty meals....

They used to be good for their "Sweet Pongal and Ven Pongal" but over the years both the quantity and quality has come down. Their south Indian coffee is good. On weekends parking is a mess and in general is not a very big set up.

Ambience is excellent .A bit of Hindi is needed as in the heart of Chennai most of the waiters are from North India or Nepal and hence cannot speak Tamil. Their idlies are not good at all and bely the name but the sakkara pongal is damn good! The food is good but service is a bit slow

what I like best there is the coffee and puribread. Fast service, and friendly staff but there uniform is very dirty. what I dont like there is flies everywhere. But stil love the coffee so much there..

I have tried this place a few times over the years. The food seems to be okay and my tender stomach was not upset. I don't mind visiting this place if I happened to be that part of the town during my visit to Chennai.
excellent veg food - Ideal family place. challenge is parking your car. full during the week ends.

Oneof the best Indian vegetation food I have eaten. The price is the same as other average restaurants. Very crowded, relatively clean because their turnover is fast. Nothing fancy about the place but great food. Eaten here many times or taken away, no digestive problems...
The sambar vadai and the onion uthappam are the best

Sangeetha restaurant in Gandhinagar Adyar is a good option if you are vegetarian. The place is not on the main road, rather on the Service lane to the main Adyar road. Parking is a nightmare, so park in one of the adjacent side streets and walk to the place. Day or night, breakfast or dinner, the place is crowded. I used to live 4 streets away and used to visit frequently for dinner. I dont recall a single instance when the place wasnt crowded. On the plus side, they have a waiting area and 10-15 mins is average waiting time. The South Indian food is very good, with some great North Indian choices. Try the Chola Puri, Pav Bhaji and the North/south fixed meals. Service levels are good, prices are reasonable.

Variety and preparations at this joint truly rivals Saravana on all aspects; but the best part of it is different types of snacks: such as Chettinad vada/bajjis/in the evening...................................
Good service of staffs, excellent veg restaurent in adyar.

I have been to this restaurant many times and most of the time time i tried their daily special items which would be very different from other vegetarian restaurants in the city and also very yummy and you cant just come out without eating atleast two items here its becoz they have a huge variety of items which are extremely good in taste and also the waiters are so pleasing that they dont hesitate at all and does a clean and very good service and to mention one important thing about this restaurant is no other sangeetha branches in the city have this extreme taste and service and in terms of taste this restaurant even over takes saravana bhavan(which was very popular among vegetarians).So this is a much visit restaurant for all the veggies..........u will just love it.... Best items here are: Just blindly try all the daily special items which they are having becoz every one of those would taste really delicious but to mention here are few.... Masala Parotta Palak Chola Poori with palak paneer kuli paniyaaram which is very soft and buffy and all the sweet items which they have and do try to visit it atleast once then u will be eager to visit it for the next time.........

This is a very good restaurant. located at Ghandhinagar. The only problem is very crowded some times have to wait more than 40 minutes to get a seat at peak times. The food quality is very good. they serve all kind of food (veg). There is also a ample parking space on the service road and valet parking is available

For South Indians, this is a home away from home, be it for meals at lunch or a 'tiffin' item like dosa, idli, et al, or for a quick cup of coffee or some snacks. The place is crowded all the time - its open from around 7 am to 10.30-11 pm; though all the dishes in the menu are not available all the time, it is mentioned very clearly in the menu and for any time of the day, there are enough varieties. Though every South Indian dish is very tasty, a few things like the pizza or the pav bhaji are good too, but be prepared for an entirely different version of these... we call it Sangeetha's pizza or pav bhaji or... You might also be surprised with the number of desserts offered.

Good place, good food, value for money, but like a Russian cant make taccos, dont expect a variety in North Indian dishes. They are lip smackingly awesome with the South Indian dishes. Helpful waiters who would go as far as recommending good food, if u dont know what to order.

Hi everybody, Dishes here are mouth watering taste particularly rava dosa, gulab jammon etc., good ambiance, good service the only drawback is you have to wait 15-20 minutes to get seated and you do not have enough space to wait. with regards, Alen_10

They are one of the most competitive hotel for Saravana Bhavan. Having good quality of food and service for pure veg. Expanding their presence in chennai very much. Variety of veg menu can be seen and with daily specailities.

Not all dishes are great. They are good at traditional south Indian  dishes but as a restaurant chain they have expanded beyond  traditional south Indian and moved to fusion and Indo chinese. Some of the Indo chinese dishes are a disaster. Hence if you are looking to try something new you are better off trying it elsewhere. Also make sure you get there ahead of time since weekends can be crazy with little or no seating at all. Parking is a nightmare.

I have been here at least twice a month for the past 10 years now. They provide the best south indian and north indian food at reasonable price. They have quite a long menu (15+ dosa varities, 30+ north indian side dishes, 20+ starters, 10+ variety rice, 4 pages of juices, ice creams and sweets) You pick any item and I bet you will like it. The service has been the best and they are keeping it up for 10 years. If you come here for lunch, don't miss the South Indian thali meals in A/C section.

We live within 600ms from this restaurant and hence visit this place so often. Kids love this place (when left with no choices) To me, this is the best veggie restaurant within the Adyar area. Love their daily specials like the Vendhiya Dosai and Vadai Curry, The Adai Avial, the always great Spl Sambar Rice. The Spl falooda is so tempting each time I visit this place. The managers, staff, cleaning team - all are very courteous and provided excellent service. The south INdian Filter coffee, the sambar vadai are too good. The pongal though small quantity, is a sure recipe for a quick nap - lots of ghee, cashews...oohhh... All the makings of a modern day Saravana Bhavan Success Story. Keep it up folks - pls move to a larger place closeby and allow the crowd to enjoy the food (than the wait) and pls plan some way of parking space. My every fav place for family, friends, quick business lunch / breakfast / coffee.

This is a nice little restaurant for a quick vegetarian meal or tiffin items. Lot of choices with some nice juices and ice creams to go with. Try their mini idlis and variety dosas - lip smacking with lots of sambar to drink with!

The food is very good and you have a variety (both south & north) and it never upsets your stomach.  Reasonably priced and the service is better than many other places, including the star hotels.  There is scope for improving the ambience, mainly because of the crowd.  But I enjoy visiting this place regularly.

Sangeetha is the best bet if you are looking for a authentic tasting south/north indian restaurant. Their onion rava & masala parota is a must have!. This restaurant has a unique naan - side dish set combination at competitve rate ( Rs40 - 50 )where u don have to buy them separately . Its helpful when u r the only one who wants to have tandoori n don have to order a full side dish n waste most. The seating is very tight at both a.c & non-ac section where u have to sit with strangers cos the crowd is so much. But when u have good food , who cares ? :)
Very nice resturant, good service, the best south indian food i never had and economical. If any one wants to try south indian vegetaren, they should not miss this. Sangeetha is very ecofriendly ...
Good food a lovely place for the best of South Indian food. Hygenic and fairly priced. Waiting time during weekends could be a problem because all people expect good food at right price.
def worth of our money at nominal cost best to our stomach mainly
The restaurant ambience was good. The quality of the food is very good. The service offered is also good.
A very good local pick. Hygienic and tasty food. Good service.
Love the Thali, parking space is a no no

I am writing about the branch of Sangeetha restaurant located at the domestic departure terminal of Chennai Airport... Agreed that we are getting good vegetarian Food from this restaurant.. Food very nice.... at what cost...? Since this is outside the Airport, we tend to believe that the cost of dishes may not be that much high when compared to the Food available inside the Airport... However our view is wrong.. Prices are very much on the higher side.. For eg:  One Masala Dosa cost Rs. 171.43 one pongal costs Rs.138.10 Idly 2 Nos.61.90 etc.... In case you would like to have a parcel/take delivery,,,,you have to pay additional charges. Can the hotel authorities check the price and make available food at a moderate cost to the passengers....
I can proudly say this restaurant serves the authentic vegetarian tamilnadu recipes. Breakfast to dinner, they serves fresh and tasty food. Good place for kids too

It is one of the best South Indian restaurant serving authentic vegetarian food. Idli, variety of dosas, wada and sambar are ultimate. Filter coffee cannot be missed. Serves North Indian vegetarian food too. Great ambience and neatly maintained
The combination of various variety of small meals looks great in the banana leaf and the flavour of ever dish is super
Whenever I upset, I go and get one Rosemilk. Rosemilk is my favourite @ Rs 50, Pongal vada also good. Accept Sodexo, Road side parking available
Good place ,Staff are Nice and listens to our Need.Good and tasty items at reasonable cost. Millet items are Best.We visit this restaurent very often
Clean & good tasty food. Never disappoints. Quick services. Had been going for the past 16 years never the quality of the food had gone down.

I stay right next to the restaurant and my family always enjoy eating there or ordering home. Though the options have Indian and Chinese, I just love the South Indian option. The food is cooked in olive oil which is healthy, but do avoid deep fried where the oil may be reused as with any other restaurant. Now a horrible neighbor. You will see sewage overflows because they don't segregate garbage and choke drains with the dumping. They bring in water tankers that disrupt the flow of traffic and encourage traffic offenders who drive against a one way street.
Visited the place after more than 10 years. Lots of traditional indian vege options and some fusion dishes. All with decent taste. Very reasonable price for chennai.
you cant miss the south indian thali here ! the wait during lunch time is a bit long though, go when you start feeling hungry and keep a buffer for 30 min to 45 min wait time.

This Sangeetha Restaurant centrally located at Gandhinagar Adyar. It is on the Main Road adjacent to Reliance Digital and Trends. They have Fast Food restaurant at the Ground Floor and AC restaurant in the First Floor. Ambiance is good.. Very clean and tidy. Service and courtesy is excellent. They have both South Indian and North Indian Food... Today we had our dinner here... having tasted their 14 idlis, Rava Onion Dosa, Idly Sambar, Mango Shake and Kesari Falooda...  Every item taken was very good... especially Kesari Kulfi Falooda. Overall this is one of the best restaurants at Chennai.

Sangeetha is the best of all the competing chains in terms of value for money.  The seating is not cluttered like the rest.. the portions are good and lastly its authentic south indian if you like.  The location of this outlet is great.. right on Sardar Patel Road and close to almost every good place in Adyar.

We frequently visiting this restaurant, never had any issues with food or heart burning feeling after having food. They said using olive oil. Almost all are tasty except few north Indian side-dish. One thing my major concern is they serve hot soup/food in melamine plates/bowl, if they replace it, that would be good. Some other restaurants use acrylic plates, I don't know how good it is. Ice cream stuff entirely need to improve. Anyway I like it this place

Every aspect of the hotel is good. It is'nt too modern nor is it too traditional. It is a decent place to eat and a place to have fun as family get together or function. It also has a Party hall, again, decent and tidy. Services offered are nice. Dishes can be customized (ie. less spicy, more onions etc.). Overall great experience and good quantity and quality of food for the price.

At sangeetha, when you order a meal (especially any kind of thali) quantity is more than filling. I love the way they serve north indian thali..plenty of options, unlimited quantity and satisfaction in the end in form of desserts! Well, the sambar is worth mentioning... the best in the city!! I had been to the outlet in France also. Though it was simple, it was certainly cost effective!
Awesome Kabudu Idli. Worth trying. The waiter did not promote this but I had to order by seeing someone else eating.

We wanted a taste of the local cuisine so sat in the cafe part rather than the resteraunt. They found someone who spoke English, who gave us excellent recommendations and provided cutlery for us. The food was lovely and the staff were very helpful. We took the rest of the group another night (although we got lost- there are several sangeetha resteraunts so make sure you all have the same address). Price is really really good, especially for the quality of the food.

I was there last week for a business lunch with my colleague. I was amazed by the way they carry the trays stacked up with food one over the other. Not sure how clean it is.. Looks like everything is mixed up. Though there were lots of colourful varieties in food, nothing tasted good to me. By far the worst south Indian restaurant that i have been to. The people who were serving the food took back the items which i did not eat.. Hope they don't serve the same to other people. I will not recommend any one to go to this restaurant.
Nice vegetarian food with a lot of variety. Gets a little too crowded over weekend for a peaceful meal
I frequently visit this hotel. Their daily speciality is good and specifically Millet dosai. Good place, heavily crowded and parking is an issue, though they provide Vallet parking
Sangeetha at Gadhi nagar is a crowded place, The place could be kept more clean and hygienic. The waiters apparently over worked and therefore do lack patience, The food is standard and good

This is one of my favorite Sangeetha restaurant branches which serves awesome veg food. The service is really fast. I prefer to sit on the ground floor (Non A/C) where the service is very good. There is no business other than eating. Food is served fast, so people come here order what they want, eat fast and leave. If you want to sit relax and have food with your family then prefer to go to first or second floor where they have A/C dining areas.  The food is really yummy and taste is awesome. There cannot be any complaints on the food they serve.
went there for meals and the service was very quick. food is tasty and the place is always crowded, ample car parking available

All simple and yummy-tasty veg food. I had Aapam-veg-stew, Oothappam and Coffee ! They were so simple and yummy ! A perfect place with minimum guarantee anytime and everytime !! Parking at times is difficult but thats ok !

We are regulars at this popular,  reasonably priced, vegetarian restaurant.  The quality and taste are uniform throughout the chain and the south Indian fare is really good. We had the South Indian thali, which was a bit too much for our senior citizen appetites ! It was the standard fare puri, kootu, poriyal, a tasty fried potato, a nice channa masala, a rather large pappadam,and a couple of other side dishes, besides sambar, rasam, curd, ..  the payasam was pretty good. We could hardly try the fruit salad with ice cream as were stuffed ! The service, led by Gokul, was friendly and efficient.

This restaurant is always full. During rush hours you are lucky if you get a table We went there for breakfast much before the rush hours hence found a table.. The service is fast and the food is tastyand hygienic.

Typical south Indian restaurant. Same taste throughout the globe. South Indian delicacies such as Masala dosa, ghee roast etc are excellent.  Service is too good. For the first time I tasted the corriander-lemon soup and it tasted good. When we didn't like the tomsto soup and just kept it aside, the supplier inquired whether there was any mistake in the soup! And we told him that there was nothing like that and we just didn't like the soup, the soup was excluded from the bill!!!!
This place is good for people who are looking for nice veg food.  But, due to popularity this place is always crowded. But good it has valet parking facility.

Located on the 1st main road, Gandhinagar , Adyar, this restaurant is popular for a fine variety of South Indian ,North Indian and Chinese starters and main course. Chaat items are also plentiful in terms of options. The restaurant serves vegetarian food only and uses the healthy olive oil as cooking medium. Good place for food.
very neat and clean....service was very fast. we had tamilnadu thali and veg biryani...but the thali stole the show...too much varity...
Tasty food served hot.We had lunch.Different lunch available depending on your appetite you can select one(Full meals /Mini meals)

Both food and ambience (a/c dining upstairs) were perfect value for money. Quick service despite the crowd, clean tables, decent veg food. We ordered quick lunch and each component of it was delicious. Mango lassi was good too .
Standard vegetarian fare at reasonable prices.They are continuously innovating with their dishes and you mya get lucky with a new dish.Their regular tiffen items are reasonably priced
go there for lunch on special occasions like festivals. simply superb.. we went for vishu special lunch. the items were made very tasty. i suggest book and go
Best place to have ghee pongal, wheat dosa, mini tiffin, ghee podi masala dosa. One of the best Sangeetha outlets in Chennai. Must try their filter coffee as well.

With a large patronage, it is perennially overcrowded with a large queue. However, the queue is exceptionally well managed. The good is great and prices at par. Very good food with wide choices. One of the top vegetarian restaurants in the city

Sangeetha provides excellent food, Indian and Chinese. It is a vegetarian restaurant. The food is excellent and cooked in olive oil. My family enjoy the option of eating there or ordering a takeaway. We reside just beside. The staff are friendly and ambience good.

Any time we go to the Elliot's beach or Adyar we end up eating here. This is one of the best hotels in Chennai for the delicious South Indian food, be it Pongal with Sambhar, Dosas with vadacurry or the varieties of Dosas. Finish it with the filter coffee and you will be delighted. For lunch, they have varieties of South Indian and North Indian food. I would rate their chilly panneer as the best. Parotta with kuruma is really yummy. The have different types of juices but don't miss the Ayurvedic juice. Very fast service is assured. This hotel is really good for their breakfast, lunch, evening snacks (South Indian and chat items) and dinner.
excellent food and service. highly recommended. place is very busy, choose the upstairs . good location, right on the main road.

I visit this place often during my office work visits from Mumbai to Chennai. Being a mumbaikar I am accustomed to south indian udupi food and can relate very easily to the food being served at Sangeethas in Adyar. This is my first stop after getting out of the flight from Mumbai. Always have breakfast here starting with Pongal wada and a dosa and a filter coffee and then head to my office. Often get my team to lunch over here. They have Punjabi and Chinese food items available and made very tasty. In my personal opinion this restaurant is way ahead of Saravana Bhuvan hotels which seemed to be hyped up a bit. Have been to Saravannas several times to but it is always Sangeetas that I prefer. Highly recommended for all

Good South Indian food. Has an air conditioned section on the first floor. If in a rush recommend find a seat at the ground floor where one can see the open kitchen. Their mini combo breakfast is a recommended option

This is one of the best place to go to if you are craving for South Indian Food. They are good in terms of ambience and service.Their Kal Dosa and Vada Curry is one among the many popular dishes they serve. They also have daily specials written on a black board at the entrance. It was on one such instance that i got a chance to try Elai Adai and it was mouth watering.They have a range of north indian dishes as well and they are pretty good as well. No wonder it is one of the favourite spots for Vegetarians around Adyar to dine in. Parking for 4 wheelers is an issue but with valet parking one needn't worry much about it.

I had earlier reviewed the outlet at T Nagar, This time it is the Adayar outlet where we (a group of three families went for dinner. The restaurant is located in a busy place and on a small road. So you need to get down and get inside your cars pretty quick. Valet parking is the only way you can get to park your car. The Non AC restarufant on the ground floor is pretty small. The AC restaurant on the first floor is large. Ambeince is good. Service is good. The place is clean and well maintained. This restaurant is ideal when you go as a group of families with people of all ages. The very very wide menu is capable of having something interesting for every age group. Try Kadubu idli & sitaphal kesari. Tastes nice and different. Even when you go as a group, different people eating different menus the average budget per person works out to Rs.200. Reasonable when you look at the ambeince, variety etc.. On Saturday nights, you need to wait for a table after 8 PM. So better be there just before 8 PM. You will not be disappointed in pciking this restaurant for your next dine out.

We went to this Restaurant last week to celebrate my Brother's Birthday Party. We were bit late to reach the Restaurant and to some more time on celebrating the Birthday inspite of the crowd they had they never let us down. And it is the best Vegeterian Restaurant avaible in Ada, I used to go there with my family if we wish to celebrate any small family gettogher. Always the food they serve are delicious .
Dont miss the mouth-watering, south-indian and north-indian dishes here. It gets very crowded during weekends, so book your table in advance.

I visited the restaurant with some friends for a business meet.The AC section is well maintained with some normal interiors.We ordered some varieties and all are good and tasty.The service is good.The location is nice and good for family get together also.We all enjoyed the meeting and also the food too.
It is typical of what you expect in a Sangeetha outlet. The combo breakfast is a great option n recommended as a sampler. Attracts crowds and gets noisy. Table spacing is a bit cramped
This place serves nice food. It remains crowded most of the times. So, expect some delay in service.

I prefer to eat most of time North indain thali most of time. Awesome Paneer butter masala and Naan. Tasted very authentic and delicious. So was their veg fried rice. My family loved it. Will visit again for a Veggie treat
This is my favorite restaurant in Adyar area for authentic vegetarian food. This is budget friendly compared to other vegetarian hotels like Saravana.
Good choice of food varieties. Always crowded and especially on Saturdays, waiting time is more. Food taste is good and the menu is huge with lot of varieties

I've been to Sangeetha several times in the last few years. Last weekend I was there with my family. The guy who was serving us came with a big smile and asked for the order. Close to the end, my 6 year old daughter wanted a a strawberry ice cream and she requested for one. It was servered with a cherry at the top. She was very thrilled to see the cherry as well. Looking at her reaction, in a minute he returned with a small cup full of cherries. At the time of settling the bill he gave two stawberries to my daughter and also thanked us at the time of leaving. As a customer, It gives me lot of  satifaction and also pleasant feeling.

Chain of signature restaurants in Chennai servers traditional south indian Udupi & Chettinad style of food. I decided to taste their breakfast items in one of their outlets in Adyar. The pongal and vadai was quite nice with multiple chutneys. The Masala Poori was quite heavy and tasty. Unfortunately their coffee was not upto the market. It was like drinking a ‘kanji with coffee flavour’. I was quite disappointed on this. Otherwise it’s a very decent, hygienic restaurant to have quality food.
Real Tasty Food, Courteous Service, Nice Ambiance.  The taste & varieties that are available cannot be compared to any other recently launched Sangeetha in the extension areas.

Taste of food is good.. Wide range..  Quick supply... The person taking order is not trained as professional.. Doesn't know to deal with the customers in good manner.. Dirty seats covered with plastic sheets are gives bad opinion about the restaurant.. Very tight parking... You can go here only for taste, not for good service...

The bustling restaurant in Adayar, is my favourite for a relaxed late breakfast on a Sunday morning Puzzling - bustling and yet relaxed atmosphere?! Well, Sunday mornings are relatively free. On a typical sunday morning, post 10 am, the A/C section in the 1st floor  caters to people who have done with their cycling or badminton; families / couples wanting to have a break from home food, etc.. The scene is quite relaxed. The attendants do not breathe on you back, and say, 'have you finished sir ? Shall I get your bill ?', as the tables do not overflow.. I normally take Sweet-lime or water melon juice, 'no-ice-no-sugar-fresh-fresh'; Sambar-Idli (2 pieces of idli will be hidden in 1000 litres of sambar!!), one crisp vadai and top it with strong filter coffee. Burp! Quirk : they do not serve juice first takes time to prepare. By force of habit, the food that is ready is served (which would be idli-sambar). Juice would be served when you are sort of slurping the last of the sambar. This does not bother me. This Sunday. I have great idly-ambar, and am forgiving!!)
Typical South Indian Food is of extremely good quality. Nice for a quick breakfast or meal. Located in a busy place, and caters to lots of crowd.
A very good Veg restaurant bang on Adayar in Chennai with reasonable parking area on the road itself. The food is tasty. The restaurant will be a bit crowded during the noon.
Visited this hotel for breakfast on the way to ECR. Neat, spacious and tasty food. Service was good too. Only issue is there is limited parking space and hence had to opt for valet parking.

Good vegetarian food, but the crowd is too much, especially on weekends and be prepared to wait for 20minutes minimum, which is crazy!!!. Once you get in to the restaurant after this ordeal outside in the hot oven, the service is good and the food too. But the ordeal outside, right from parking to waiting is terrible.
Great variety of veg food , cooked in healthy manner, fast service and priced just right. Good south indian menu , does serve other cuisine
More hype created but its OK hotel particularly for a person like me from Mumbai. Nothing great to experience. Lot of crowd - you may have to wait during peak hours.

This restaurant has delicious Indian food (both South and North Indian) and the service is exceptional as well. Inspite of the large variety the service is fast with a consistent quality. The place is clean though crowded at times.
Had a good time in this restaurant. The food is good and at a very decent price. The waiters don't speak a word of English though. Still a good price/quality. Recommend

I honestly believe that, even the best among all the Sangeetha's in Chennai. Snow white fluffy idlys with podi, green, white (the best) and red chutneys, crisp vadas, dosas (crisp or with less oil - as you like it), delicious sooji halwa and strong filter coffee - it absolutely makes my day when it starts with breakfast in the Gandhi Nagar Sangeetha. Wonder why I don't go more often?!
The restaurant is located in busiest place yet it finds its silence. Mostly busy. Its a good place to go as a family and enjoy an evening snack or a dinner. Taste is good.

It looks very easy for the localities waiting outside for getting seated inside this restaurant, but worth the wait, food qualtiy is awesome, dont forget to try the Ela Adai, a sweet, very nicely done as done at home
Very popular in the area. So, it is crowded most of the time. The food is ok and service is prompt. But the ambience is not so great.

When a veg restaurant gets 5 star rating from me, that in its is an achievement for the place. This place has a wide wide variety of speed available and all of them are amazing. Price is like any other good vegetarian restaurant. My personal favorite is honey chilli potato. You just want to eat more of that. They have lots of items for starters/main course/desserts/sweets, everything. Try this out.

I had South Indian thali meals recently. It was only a o.k experience. The papad was not crisp... The curd was very bitter,the hand wash place was not very hygienic. Having said that the sambar and rasam were quite good. The Chapstick and potato curry were quite good. The service was not that efficient... I spite of too many supervisors and waiter for the small AC place

We were on shopping trip to Chennai from 5th to 8th of June 2015. After shopping for clothes at an Handloom Shop run by the Village Industries Board, we decided to have brunch at Sangeetha at Gandhi Nagar. Being a saturday afternoon, the restaurant was sparsely crowded. We started with a butter dosa - nice a crispy one - with chutines followed by Dahi Bhalla or Curd Vadai - South Indian type - which was the right items for the hot day at 34 deg. C. To satisfy the sweet buds we shared a Ras Malai. Then we decided to have the strong filter coffee with milk but no sugar to wash down the food. As the caffine hit the tongue, the aroma and taste swept us off the feet. Good food - good times. Rs. 400/- for two.

The food quality is excellent. The variety of dishes is also great. Weekends do get quite crowded. Plan early and if possible book a reservation. The quick lunch is quite filling and helps if your looking for an affordable quick eat. The veg Biriyani is quite filling as well.
Sangeetha provides good and hygiene food for reasonable food. I visited couple of times with my family. Food is tasty and served in time.
Sangeetha Adyar provide very good lunch @ reasonable price. The food quality was very good and enough also! The service was also good. Overall good place to eat with family!
An excellent choice for those seeking south Indian food. Located centrally and is a prominent landmark by itself. Great value food and lovely meals. A wide variety of dosas as well. Recommended.
